questions.question: Which city hosted the 2024 Summer Olympic Games?
questions.explanation: Paris hosted the Games in July and August 2024, 100 years after it last did so.

questions.question: Which three countries co-host the 2026 FIFA World Cup?
questions.explanation: The 2026 tournament is hosted jointly by the United States, Canada and Mexico, the first with three host nations.

questions.question: Which city will host the 2028 Summer Olympics?
questions.explanation: Los Angeles was awarded the 2028 Games. Brisbane follows in 2032.

questions.question: Which country hosted the 2022 FIFA World Cup?
questions.explanation: Qatar hosted the 2022 tournament, held in November and December.

questions.question: Which country became the 32nd member of NATO in March 2024?
questions.explanation: Sweden joined in March 2024, following Finland in April 2023.

questions.question: Which company released the chatbot ChatGPT in November 2022?
questions.explanation: OpenAI released ChatGPT on 30 November 2022, and it helped bring generative AI into the mainstream.

questions.question: Which space telescope, launched on 25 December 2021, observes mainly in infrared?
questions.explanation: The James Webb Space Telescope orbits the Sun–Earth L2 point and observes mainly in infrared light.

questions.question: Which city hosted the COP28 climate summit in 2023?
questions.explanation: COP28 took place in Dubai, United Arab Emirates, from late November to mid-December 2023.

questions.question: On which date did the United Kingdom formally leave the European Union?
questions.explanation: The UK left on 31 January 2020. A transition period then ran until 31 December 2020.

questions.question: Who succeeded Queen Elizabeth II as monarch of the United Kingdom in September 2022?
questions.explanation: Charles III became king on the death of Queen Elizabeth II on 8 September 2022.

questions.question: Which social media platform was rebranded as 'X' in 2023?
questions.explanation: Twitter was renamed X in July 2023.

questions.question: Which country won the 2023 FIFA Women's World Cup?
questions.explanation: Spain beat England 1–0 in the final in Sydney, in a tournament co-hosted by Australia and New Zealand.

questions.question: In which year was the Paris Agreement on climate change adopted?
questions.explanation: The agreement was adopted in December 2015 at COP21 in Paris.

questions.question: The Tokyo Olympic Games, originally planned for 2020, were postponed to 2021 because of what?
questions.explanation: The Games were held in July and August 2021 and kept the name Tokyo 2020.
